# The BSP is a separate cmake project, so the ML-DSA and ML-KEM state is read back from the
# xilasu config header it generates. A disabled feature renders as an #undef comment and
# contributes no entry, so a non-empty list means at least one of the two is enabled.
set(ASUFW_BSP_CONFIG_HEADER "${CMAKE_INCLUDE_PATH}/xasu_bsp_config.h")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ASUFW_BSP_CONFIG_HEADER}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "asufw: xilasu config header '${ASUFW_BSP_CONFIG_HEADER}' not found; the ML-DSA and "
    "ML-KEM build configuration cannot be determined.")
endif()
file(STRINGS "${ASUFW_BSP_CONFIG_HEADER}" ASUFW_PQC_CONFIG_LINES
     REGEX "^#define[ \t]+XASU_ML(DSA|KEM)_ENABLE")

collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS xilstandalone)
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS xil)
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS xiltimer)
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS xilasu)
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS xilasu_mbv)
# ML-DSA and ML-KEM share a single liboqs archive, so it is linked as soon as either one is
# enabled. With both off it must be left out: the BSP deletes liboqs_mbv.a in that case, so an
# unconditional -loqs_mbv would not resolve.
if(ASUFW_PQC_CONFIG_LINES)
  collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS oqs_mbv)
endif()
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS gcc)
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS c)

aux_source_directory(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} _sources)
foreach (source ${_sources})
    get_filename_component(ext ${source} EXT)
    list(APPEND src_ext ${ext})
endforeach()

if (NOT DEFINED PROJECT_TYPE)
find_project_type ("${src_ext}" PROJECT_TYPE)
endif()

if("${PROJECT_TYPE}" STREQUAL "c++")
collect(PROJECT_LIB_DEPS stdc++)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER})
endif()

collector_list (_deps PROJECT_LIB_DEPS)
list (APPEND _deps ${USER_LINK_LIBRARIES})
message(STATUS "deps is:" ${_deps})

collector_list (_sources PROJECT_LIB_SOURCES)
collector_list (_headers PROJECT_LIB_HEADERS)
list (APPEND _sources ${USER_COMPILE_SOURCES})
file(COPY ${_headers} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include)
set(ASUFW_COMPILE_OPTIONS " -O2 -flto -ffat-lto-objects")
set(ASUFW_LINK_OPTIONS " -march=rv32imac_zicsr_zifencei -mabi=ilp32")
string(APPEND CMAKE_C_FLAGS ${ASUFW_COMPILE_OPTIONS})
string(APPEND CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS ${ASUFW_COMPILE_OPTIONS})
string(APPEND CMAKE_C_LINK_FLAGS ${ASUFW_LINK_OPTIONS})
string(APPEND CMAKE_CXX_LINK_FLAGS ${ASUFW_LINK_OPTIONS})

# These translation units are relocated into the DDR-backed overlay sections by
# the OVERLAY blocks in lscript.ld: the RSA, ECC, ECIES and LMS drivers, and the
# key vault blob layers, which the resident key manager calls into once it has
# activated their image.
# Compile them with:
#   -fno-lto : keep each a distinct object with real, linker-selectable
#              machine-code sections. LTO would merge them into the combined
#              image and defeat the per-object section placement.
#   -msmall-data-limit=0 : disable the small-data area for these objects. Their
#              .text sits in the IRAM overlay window while their data
#              (.rodata/.data/.bss) sits in the far data RAM overlay window.
#              gp-relative small-data addressing assumes data sits within +/-2KB
#              of __global_pointer$, which is not true across the overlay
#              windows, so it must be disabled to force absolute/PC-relative
#              data references.
set(ASUFW_OVERLAY_SOURCES
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ecc/xecc.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/rsa_ecc/xrsa.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/rsa_ecc/xrsa_ecc.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/rsa_ecc/xrsa_eccinfo.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/rsa_ecc/xrsa_padding.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lms/xlms.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lms/xlms_core.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lms/xlms_ots.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ecies/xecies.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slhdsa/xslhdsa.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slhdsa/xslhdsa_core.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slhdsa/xslhdsa_hash.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/keymanager/xkeymanager_aekv.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/keymanager/xkeymanager_chunk.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/keymanager/xkeymanager_crypto.c
	${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/overlay/xoverlay_sections.c)
set_source_files_properties(${ASUFW_OVERLAY_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fno-lto;-msmall-data-limit=0")

add_dependency_on_bsp(_sources)
add_executable(${APP_NAME}.elf ${_sources})
string (REPLACE ";" ",-l" _deps "${_deps}")
set(_linker_command "-Wl,-Map=${APP_NAME}.map -Wl,--build-id=none -Wl,--gc-sections -T\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lscript.ld\" -L\"${CMAKE_LIBRARY_PATH}/\" -L\"${USER_LINK_DIRECTORIES}/\" -Wl,--start-group,-l${_deps} -Wl,--end-group")
# lscript.ld defaults to the stack and heap the ML-DSA and ML-KEM paths need: the deep frames of
# liboqs signing and encapsulation, and a heap for the aligned allocations its SHA3 layer makes.
# With both features off nothing reaches the allocator and those frames are gone, so hand the
# space back to the resident instruction RAM the two sections are carved from.
if(NOT ASUFW_PQC_CONFIG_LINES)
  string(APPEND _linker_command " -Wl,--defsym=_STACK_SIZE=0x2000 -Wl,--defsym=_HEAP_SIZE=0x0")
endif()
set_target_properties(${APP_NAME}.elf PROPERTIES LINK_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lscript.ld)
target_link_libraries(${APP_NAME}.elf ${_linker_command})
target_compile_definitions(${APP_NAME}.elf PUBLIC ${USER_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS})
target_include_directories(${APP_NAME}.elf PUBLIC ${USER_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES} ${PROJECT_LIB_HEADERS})
print_build_info_target(${APP_NAME}.elf "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}" "${USER_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}" "${CMAKE_C_LINK_FLAGS}" "${_linker_command}")
print_elf_size(CMAKE_SIZE ${APP_NAME})
